summary.en: Oklahoma City Thunder All-Star Jalen Williams has been diagnosed with a fractured left fibula and a dislocated ankle and will undergo surgery, general manager Sam Presti confirmed at a press conference on Monday. Williams suffered the injury with 1:14 remaining in Sunday's 108-101 win over the Los Angeles Clippers, landing awkwardly after colliding in mid-air with Kris Dunn and Derrick Jones Jr. Presti would not say whether Williams will miss the rest of the season until doctors have operated, with a recovery timeline to follow. Guard Cason Wallace also needs surgery after suffering a torn labrum in his left shoulder in the same game, and both players are expected to miss a significant portion of the season.

summary.en: Ajay Mitchell scored a career-high 30 points and Shai Gilgeous-Alexander added 26 as the short-handed Oklahoma City Thunder beat the Phoenix Suns 125-114 to stay perfect at 4-0. Mitchell, starting in place of the injured Jalen Williams, scored 18 points in the first half, while Jared McCain added 18 and Isaiah Hartenstein had 15 points and 13 rebounds. Devin Booker was held to three points on 1-for-7 shooting for Phoenix, with Jalen Green scoring 20. The Thunder were already without Williams and Cason Wallace, who both need surgery, and Chet Holmgren missed the game with knee tendinitis; Alex Caruso also left in the second quarter with a sprained right ankle and did not return.

summary.en: The Dallas Cowboys beat the Philadelphia Eagles 38-21 on the road on Monday night to snap a two-game losing streak. Dallas rushed for 204 yards, with running back Javonte Williams carrying 25 times for a career-high 155 yards and a touchdown. Quarterback Dak Prescott threw for 212 yards and three touchdowns, two of them to CeeDee Lamb. The Eagles briefly led 21-20 in the third quarter before Dallas scored 18 unanswered points. Philadelphia has now lost five straight and falls to 2-5, while Dallas improves to 3-4 and stays in the NFC East race. With Jalen Hurts out for the season with blood clots in his lungs, backup Tanner McKee threw for 211 yards with a touchdown and an interception.

summary.en: The Golden State Warriors beat the Denver Nuggets 134-114 on the road on Monday night for their first win of the season, avoiding their first 0-4 start since 2007-08. Rookie Yaxel Lendeborg scored 31 points with 12 rebounds, and Stephen Curry scored 21 of his 24 points in the second half, finishing 8-of-8 from the field — the first time in his career he has scored 20 or more points without missing a shot. Golden State shot 54.1% from the field, including 22-of-44 from three-point range, and scored 74 points after half-time. Denver's Nikola Jokic had 19 points, seven rebounds and 11 assists as the Nuggets' defence collapsed after the break.

summary.en: Bayern Munich and England striker Harry Kane has won the 2026 men's Ballon d'Or at a ceremony at the London Palladium, edging Kylian Mbappe and Lamine Yamal in a tight race. The 33-year-old scored 73 goals in 65 matches across all competitions for club and country last season, helping Bayern win the Bundesliga and DFB-Pokal double, and also collected the Gerd Muller Trophy as the year's top striker earlier in the evening. Kane is the first Englishman to win the award since Michael Owen in 2001, the fifth English winner overall, and the first Bayern Munich player to claim it since Karl-Heinz Rummenigge in 1981. Barcelona midfielder Alexia Putellas won the women's Ballon d'Or for a third time.
summary.zh_hans: 拜仁慕尼黑及英格兰前锋凯恩在伦敦帕拉迪姆剧院举行的颁奖礼上，夺得 2026 年度男子金球奖，力压姆巴佩及亚马尔。33 岁的凯恩上季在球会及国家队各项赛事 65 场攻入 73 球，协助拜仁夺得德甲及德国杯双冠王，同晚稍早亦已获颁表扬最佳射手的穆勒奖。凯恩是自 2001 年欧文以来首位夺得金球奖的英格兰球员，也是历来第五位英格兰得主，以及自 1981 年鲁梅尼格以来首位拜仁球员获此殊荣。巴塞罗那中场普迪拉斯第三度夺得女子金球奖。

summary.en: Donovan Mitchell hit the tiebreaking mid-range jumper with 48 seconds left in overtime as the Cleveland Cavaliers rallied from a 15-point deficit to beat the previously unbeaten Minnesota Timberwolves 127-125 at home on Monday night. Mitchell finished with 26 points and seven assists, James Harden added 19 points and nine assists, and Evan Mobley had 18 points and 10 rebounds for Cleveland, who improved to 2-1. Anthony Edwards scored a season-high 47 points for Minnesota, including a buzzer-beating three-pointer, but missed a wide-open three with 3.9 seconds left in overtime that would have tied the game.

summary.en: Hong Kong lost 18-35 to Jiangsu, winners of the National Games gold medal, in their fourth game of the 2025-26 China Handball Super League men's finals at Ma On Shan Sports Centre on Tuesday. The hosts, the only amateur side in the competition, trailed 7-20 at half-time after Jiangsu pulled away to 10-3 early on. Goalkeeper Tong Tsz-hin was the bright spot, making 10 saves in about 35 minutes at a 33.3 per cent save rate — more than Jiangsu's two goalkeepers combined. Hong Kong, who beat Shanghai 28-27 before losing to Anhui and Beijing, are now 1-3. They face the U20 team on Friday, October 30 at 8pm.

summary.en: Shanghai Port lost 2-3 at home to Cong An Ha Noi in the third round of the AFC Champions League Elite on Tuesday, ending a 13-match unbeaten run. Brayan Perea scored twice and Leo Artur added one for the Vietnamese champions, who led three times and held on through a retaken penalty and nine minutes of added time. Prince Ampem and Miguel Campos twice levelled for Port, before Perea struck the winner in the 69th minute. The win, Cong An Ha Noi's first of the season, takes them to three points, one behind Port. About 18,000 fans watched at Pudong Football Stadium, where the visitors won despite having only 35 per cent of possession.

summary.en: Beijing Guoan drew 2-2 with Jeonbuk Hyundai Motors at Workers' Stadium in the third round of the AFC Champions League Elite on Tuesday. Motta headed Jeonbuk in front in the second minute, and Du Qiake levelled in the 33rd minute after a free kick. Wang Gang, 37, put Guoan ahead in the 52nd minute, following up after Akolo's shot was saved for his first goal of the season. Lee Young-jae equalised for Jeonbuk from a corner in the 65th minute, and the game finished 2-2. Guoan remain unbeaten in the competition after three rounds with two wins and a draw. Before kick-off, fans in the north stand unveiled the first hanging TIFO at Workers' Stadium, themed 'Guoan spirit'.
